warnings.message: At least one declared true class is absent. Supported-class macro F1 and balanced accuracy exclude absent true classes.
Sample independence is not documented; row-level intervals do not account for correlated patients or batches.
The supplied study role is not locked independent evaluation; do not represent these results as a new blind test.
Every study_id contains only one observed class; study-specific variation cannot be separated from true class effects.
Confidence scores and expected calibration error are descriptive; clinical calibration is not demonstrated.

interpretation.frozen_threshold: Frozen reference if predeclared in input manifest or source config; historical references are not newly blinded.
interpretation.exploratory_thresholds: All other cutoffs are post hoc displays of the same predictions; their apparent performance must not be claimed as independent confirmation.
interpretation.intervals: Wilson scores and stratified bootstrap describe sample-level uncertainty under independence assumptions; neither accounts for unmeasured study, batch, or patient clustering.
interpretation.performance: External accuracy is conditional on the observed cohort and class support, not universal clinical transportability.
